scope.population_context: people under 18 using or able to access text-based consumer conversational AI
scope.data: 80 fully synthetic three-user-turn conversations in 20 counterfactual families

measurement_model.background_goal: proportionate, agency-preserving support and handoff decisions for children using conversational AI
measurement_model.systematized_construct: conformance to provisional ChildEsc v0.1 action and recipient constraints
measurement_model.measurement_instrument: synthetic conversations, ordered action schema, permitted and forbidden recipient sets, and deterministic scorer
measurement_model.instance_level_measurements: predicted action, predicted recipient set, target validity, exact-route correctness, and atomic failure reasons

claim_boundary: Reported scores diagnose conformance to the provisional v0.1 specification and do not establish child-centeredness, clinical validity, recipient safety, model superiority, or deployment readiness.
